scope.identity_evidence: The task independently confirms all ten application/plugin/prompt identities. Each assessed capture also identifies the frozen application in initial_repositories. No new identity experiment was performed.

scope.constraints_observed: No app experiments, agents launched or messaged, prompt tuning, repository edits, or input modifications. Only completed immutable watcher captures are graded.

collection.conclusion: All five Sidekiq captures arrived within the waiting limit. Pending Rails captures are outside this assessment. No incomplete attempt is assigned a score.

method.actionable: All of impact, applicability and recommendation must be supported. Counts have denominator two; other risks do not create recall families.
method.fully_specified_validation: Validation must be supported separately: public real-Redis/worker results plus all discriminating scenario/control criteria. Proposed checks, suite names, native model reports, and uncollected nested logs are not independently observed passing experiments.
method.SK1_impact_boundary: Strict rejection/500 alone is partial impact. Full impact includes the queued Export row without a job/job ID caused by symbol rejection. An orphan described only for Redis outage is credited separately, not silently transferred to the strict-arguments scenario.
method.SK1_validation: Real Redis/worker, persisted job ID, completed export, exact ordered Markdown bytes, and rejection queue/row state.
method.SK2_validation: Real Redis first/duplicate, another reader, another UTC day, enqueue-failure reservation release, and both versions when proposing preparatory code.
method.equivalent_repairs: Portable array SADD == 1 and explicit true-or-1 acceptance are valid. Target-only integer comparison requires an explicit coupled deployment constraint. Run 3 ultimately selects the portable array form with an Integer check in its authored rollout order.
method.raw_source: The native main_tool_trace Agent return for maintain-rails:gem-upgrade-planner, including all authored framing and reviewer-like notes. background_planner_report is null in the assessed captures.
method.normalization: Remove only native [Subagent hand-back] prefix, exactly two leading harness spaces per report line, and trailing native agentId/usage. Retain all authored text. Final_response is graded independently without rewriting.
method.evidence_boundary: The visible main traces collect skill invocation, version grep, and the native planner hand-back. No independently collected Redis/worker/test output or post-planner git status is present in those traces. Authored artifact-presence/clean-checkout claims are model output, not extra tools or nested logs.
method.counts_reconciliation: For each layer, actionable counts derive from the three supported judgments; fully_specified_validation counts derive from supported validation judgments. Exact quote membership and source-capture hashes are checked against the immutable inputs.

source_checks_outside_captures.conclusion: Both CLIs use RAILS_MAX_THREADS for concurrency when explicit CLI/config concurrency is absent. Runs 2 and 4 are correct to offer that override; no application wiring is required. This source read is not a new application experiment or evidence that a planner ran a check.

Scalar sadd emits its deprecation warning inside the command method; wrapping its result with true-or-1 acceptance does not suppress it. Array sadd/srem return Integer on baseline. Supports warning-claim corrections in runs 2 and 4.
verify_json checks only :raise and :warn modes; false skips both. Supports run 5's bridge-description correction without changing credit for its primary decimal/string-key repairs.

totals.interpretation: Every layer contains valid selected repairs and correct SADD semantics. SK1 has only partial full application impact: no run links Symbol rejection to the queued-row/no-job state, although all discuss outage orphans separately. SK2 is actionable in all. Complete selected validation is absent, not proof that no checks ran. These are not overall correctness passes.
